summary: Male hunter overdue since 2130 the previous night near Schilling Springs near Terrace Reservoir; found by fellow hunters who escorted him to Incident Command.
location: near Schilling Springs / Terrace Reservoir, Conejos County
notes: Run 184 Conejos Citizen sweep: AVSAR log, Conejos County request, IC at FS Rd 250/251. SARDOC Oct 22 2015 mission report: missing 53-year-old hunter at FSR 250, Conejos County; went hunting with his father at the end of FSR 250 and was supposed to meet back at the truck at 0930 Wednesday Oct 21 but did not return (medical condition unknown; rain turning to snow at 10,000 ft). A SARDOC trailing dog team was stood down en route when the subject was reported located alive. TIME DISCREPANCY: AVSAR log has him overdue since 2130 the previous night; SARDOC has 0930 Wednesday; both agree FSR 250/251, Conejos, 10/22, male hunter found alive.
